caseNameFull: B. F. Meharg v. Alabama Power Company
summary: Error to the Supreme Court of the State of Alabama.
attorneys: Mr. Oscár W. Underwood and Mr. D. H. Riddle for plaintiff in error. Mr. Thomas W. Martin and Mr. O. R. Hood for defendant in error.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

Dismissed for want of jurisdiction upon the authority of § 237 of the Judicial Code, as amended by the Act of September 6, 1916, c. 448, 39 Stat. 726.
